name: cdm/observable/asset/FloatingRateIndex
description: Specification of an interest rate index which can change over time, e.g. the SONIA (Sterling Overnight Index Average) in the UK.

assetClass.description: The Asset Class of the Index.

exchange.description: If the Asset is listed, defines the public exchange of the listing.

floatingRateIndex.description: The reference index that is used to specify the floating interest rate.

identifier.description: Asset Identifiers are used to uniquely identify an Asset, using a specified Asset Identifier Type.

indexTenor.description: The ISDA Designated Maturity, i.e. the floating rate tenor.

isExchangeListed.description: Defines whether the Asset is listed on a public exchange.

provider.description: The organisation that creates or maintains the Index.

relatedExchange.description: Provides the related Exchanges, if applicable.

taxonomy.description: Defines the taxonomy of an object by combining a taxonomy source (i.e. the rules to classify the object) and a value (i.e. the output of those rules on the object.
